## Workspaces

- [Create Service Account Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/service_accounts/create.md): Tagged ID (`user_...`/`svac_...`) of the actor who created this membership.
- [Create Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/create.md): Create Workspace

- [Delete Service Account Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/service_accounts/delete.md): Tagged service account ID (`svac_...`) named in the delete request. Removal is idempotent; see the endpoint description for the implicit-membership no-op.
- [Delete Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/members/delete.md): Delete Workspace Member

- [Get Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/members/retrieve.md): Get Workspace Member
- [List Service Account Workspace Members](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/service_accounts/list.md): Tagged ID (`user_...`/`svac_...`) of the actor who created this membership.
- [List Workspace Members](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/members/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [List Workspace Rate Limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/rate_limits/list.md): Rate-limit entries for the workspace, one per group that has at least one override.
- [List Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Members](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/members.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Rate Limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/rate_limits.md): Rate-limit entries for the workspace, one per group that has at least one override.
- [Service Accounts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/service_accounts.md): Tagged ID (`user_...`/`svac_...`) of the actor who created this membership.
- [Update Service Account Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces/service_accounts/update.md): Tagged ID (`user_...`/`svac_...`) of the actor who created this membership.
